title: Reading Practice
author: Gatsby · 原创示例
description: 用原创短句练习阅读，在语境中理解表达。

units.context: I noticed a small library near the station.
The reading room is quiet in the morning.
We read one chapter before breakfast.
The new student is curious about every story.

title: Everyday Conversation
author: Gatsby · 原创示例
description: 原创日常对话示例，不摘录影视字幕。

units.context: Could you repeat that? I missed the street name.
A walk after lunch? That sounds good.
units.note: sound + 形容词表示听起来如何。

units.context: Let me check the timetable before we leave.
units.note: let + 宾语 + 动词原形。

title: Core Vocabulary
author: Gatsby · 原创示例
description: 常用单词与原创例句，适合尝试翻卡和拼写。

units.context: An accurate map helps us find the new library.
Read the whole paragraph to understand the context.
Please do not hesitate to ask a question.
units.note: hesitate to do = 犹豫做某事。

units.context: Short reviews help me retain useful expressions.

title: Phrases in Practice
author: Gatsby · 原创示例
description: 从原创生活场景中练习固定搭配。

units.context: I look forward to visiting your new studio.
units.note: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

units.context: Let us take a break after this exercise.
Regular practice helps us make progress.
units.note: progress 在此为不可数名词。

units.context: Keep the opening hours in mind when planning your visit.
